title: Athletics
html:
Athletics is a Strength-based Skill.

The higher a creature's Strength Score, the more likely they will succeed Athletics Checks, including resisting being shoved.

“
Stay fit. Perform physical stunts.
„
— In-game skill description

Proficiency

Characters who are proficient in Athletics can add their Proficiency Bonus when making  Ability Checks.

The following backgrounds grant proficiency in Athletics:

  •  Outlander
  •  Soldier

The following classes can choose to select Athletics as a proficient skill at Level 1:

  •  Barbarian
  •  Bard
  •  Fighter
  •  Monk
  •  Paladin
  •  Ranger
  •  Rogue

Uses

  • Used to  Shove other creatures
  • Used to resist being  Shoved (Either Athletics or Acrobatics, whichever is higher)
